name: loom
goal: Run repeated joins, overlapping diamonds, and all required terminal leaves.

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('evidence/A.txt'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); p.write_text('A\n', encoding='utf-8')

steps.prompt: Read evidence/A.txt. Write only evidence/B.txt with one concise observation. Do not choose a successor or edit another path.
Read evidence/A.txt. Write only evidence/C.txt with a separate concise observation. Do not choose a successor or edit another path.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('evidence/B.txt').is_file() and Path('evidence/C.txt').is_file(); Path('evidence/D.txt').write_text('D\n', encoding='utf-8')

steps.prompt: Read evidence/D.txt. Write only evidence/E.txt. Do not edit another path.
Read evidence/D.txt. Write only evidence/F.txt. Do not edit another path.
Read evidence/D.txt. Write only evidence/G.txt. Do not edit another path.
Read accepted E and F evidence. Write only evidence/H.txt. Do not edit another path.
Read accepted F and G evidence. Write only evidence/I.txt. Do not edit another path.

argv: from pathlib import Path; assert Path('evidence/H.txt').is_file() and Path('evidence/I.txt').is_file(); Path('evidence/J.txt').write_text('J\n', encoding='utf-8')

steps.prompt: Read evidence/J.txt. Write only evidence/K.txt as a terminal result. Do not edit another path.
Read evidence/J.txt. Write only evidence/L.txt as an independent terminal result. Do not edit another path.
Write only evidence/M.txt as an independent terminal note. Do not select another step or edit another path.
